Chan records most often use the idiom to appraise copied words or conduct in public exchanges. When a student repeats the form of an earlier answer, Gulin Qingmao calls it drawing a gourd from the model and rebukes him. Another record explicitly denies that its handling of an old case is following another's heels or drawing a gourd from the model. A later address applies the phrase across famous lineage gestures: the Buddha holding up the flower, Bodhidharma facing the wall, Linji's shout, and Deshan's staff are followed by descendants who 'each draw a gourd following the model.' The Zen deviation is this ordinary craft-copying idiom used to audit repeated case answers, gestures, verses, and recorded lineages. Since masters also use it self-referentially, the phrase is not condemnation by definition.

Senses.Explanation: Gave a shout is the records' stock narrative formula for one performed vocal move in a public interview or teaching-seat event. Muzhou Daoming uses it after an unnamed monk shouts at him, asks what comes after three or four shouts, and strikes when no words follow. Feiyin Tongrong shouts amid a high-seat address and says that without stopping the entangling talk with a shout it would nearly have gone on without end (若不喝住，幾乎打葛藤無有了時也). Nanyue Falun Qitian performs four shouts in sequence and labels them respectively “the lion roars,” “the elephant king stretches,” “a mad dog chases a clod,” and “a shrimp cannot leap out of the dipper”; these are four stated comparisons, not four senses. Elsewhere an unnamed monk shouts and exits, Yunfu Zhi shouts before ascending the formal seat and offering incense, and Feiyin shouts before returning to the abbot's quarters. The same formula can close an address, combine with planting the staff, or precede questions to the assembly. Chan records preserve the shout as a positioned public move; the entry reports that position and any stated classification without assigning it an unstated force.

Senses.Explanation: Under a shout is the recurrent location the Chan record gives to recognition, judgment, or failure at a recorded shout; it is not simply the shout itself. Muzhou Daoming asks how guest and host are distinguished there, while Wanru Tongwei says guest and host stand clear there. In Shimen Yuncong's record, an unnamed questioner asks what an affair under a shout is; Shimen answers that he does not engage in that business and calls it outside the questioner's sphere. Yulin Tongxiu reopens the report that Baizhang greatly awakened under Mazu's shout. The phrase does not guarantee approval. Ruixiang Zilai calls acceptance under a shout a burial of the house style; Yuanwu Keqin pairs it with catching an empty echo; Zhongfeng Mingben calls clarifying the school there dull and eye-blinding. Tianyin Yuanxiu and Wuyi Yuanlai nevertheless use the same location for knowing where to return or communicating the news. The exhaustive ledger separates this lexical construction from 319 adjacent action sequences, chiefly 'shout once' followed by 'leave the seat.' Those joins contain the two characters but not this phrase.
